V 0.0.9 updates:

"📢 THE LAST KING – Dev Update 🛡️🔥
Here's what's new in the latest build:

---

🌍 World & Environment
A brand new Greece map has been added!
Massive rock formations help guide different areas.
Regional foliage, bushes, and trees bring life to the world.
Hidden caves and lizard camps are now in!
Dusk & dawn lighting improved for better visibility.

---

⚒️ Crafting & Resources
Crafting system has been updated with more depth.
Resources are now placed around the new map.
Armor now includes leveling progression.
More weapons added – all usable by player and units.
Crafted armor now reflects correct unit classes.

---

🗡️ Player Special Moves
Sword Tornado 🌪️
Sword Whirlwind
Head Slash
Sword Air Juggle
Spear Lance Charge
Spear Dance
Spear Low Sweep
Spear Driller
Bow & Arrow 1, 2, 3 🏹

---

🏛️ New Greek Unit Classes
Javelin Thrower  [Peltist]
Dual Blade Strategos
Two-Handed Strategos
Sarissa Strategos
Aetos (Demi-God Class) ⚡
Slinger

---

🐍 New Faction
Lizard faction added with their own camps!

---

🏕️ Persian Camps
Now fully working in the new Greece map.

---

🧠 UI & Gameplay Improvements
Player Abilities UI & Unit List UI added.
Unit Upgrade system is now more user-friendly.
Upgrading keeps your unit selection intact.
Skill points now update in real time.
Upgrade button behavior improved.
Abilities are now preserved after unit upgrade.

---

🎯 Combat Tweaks
Peltists throw at a more realistic pace.
Peltists now kick when unequipped."
